description: Read and write CardDAV address books: contacts, groups and photos over the open standard
name: io.github.ni-c/carddav-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Root of the CardDAV server, e.g. https://dav.example.net. An address book collection URL also works.
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_URL

environmentVariables.description: Account name. Most hosted services want an app-specific password with it.
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password. Deleted from the environment once read.
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, as an alternative to username and password. Not both.
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated address books this server may touch, by path or final path segment. Default: all of them.
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_ADDRESSBOOKS

environmentVariables.description: Contacts a listing returns by default, 1 to 500 (default: 100)
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_MAX_CONTACTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate on the configured host only (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_INSECURE_TLS

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow a plain http:// URL to a host that is not loopback, which sends the credentials and every contact unencrypted (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left
environmentVariables.name: CARDDAV_DENY_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Deliberately unprefixed, and reaches every MCP server in the environment. Set to false to make guarded tools use the two-call token instead of a dialog (default: true)
environmentVariables.name: ELICITATION

title: CardDAV address books
